selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the method-type anchor because sign-preserving adoption triage is the load-bearing missing artifact, whereas another fidelity score would leave the bottleneck intact. A controlled diagnostic blocks the artifact-conditioning confound by comparing a paper-specific intervention and a matched sham on user-locked tasks, yielding an empirical sign and partial order rather than a reproduction score; it does not regress to generic partial-fidelity pilots, learning-curve prediction, or direct with/without-skill evaluation.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This sibling shares the anchor's evaluation framework because each matched intervention-control record can carry task utility, resource cost, adaptation effort, and guardrail regressions in the same units. The controlled diagnostic keeps the task case, model, environment, seed, and execution envelope fixed across arms, so a cost-adjusted paired effect measures net benefit instead of confounding gross gain with unequal operating conditions.

deliverable_coverage: method - the anchor gap's controlled_diagnostic_design leg yields ClaimProbe, a runnable paired micro-reproduction instrument with an abstaining sign-and-ranking decision rule.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: Deferred as a separate representativeness study: this candidate locks the existing real user-task packet to block artifact-conditioned task generation, but does not claim that the eight rows characterize the user's entire future task distribution.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Deferred as future work: the available eight-row real-reuse suite can falsify within-scope sign and rank prediction, but claiming calibration across the full paper-family, model, environment, and budget product space would require a separate, substantially larger study.
